label: Contract Review and Management Team
blurb: A Contract Operations Lead and 4 specialists who organize agreements, compare terms, and track contractual obligations
purpose: Designed for business owners, leaders, and teams executing on contract review and management. Organize agreements, compare terms, and track contractual obligations. The team coordinates research, analysis, operational planning, and structured deliverables to drive measurable results.

project.name: Contract Review and Management
project.goal: Deliver a comprehensive initial contract review and management plan with clear milestones, assigned responsibilities, and verified outputs.
